sections.title: Chapter 1 - Why math first: the map

keyTerms.definition: Linear algebra, probability and statistics, calculus, optimization; information theory on top.

recall.question: What are the four pillars?
recall.answer: Linear algebra, probability and statistics, calculus, optimization; information theory gives meaning to the loss.

recall.question: Why math first?
recall.answer: Machine learning wears a software costume; remove the frameworks and four pillars remain.

recall.question: What does each chapter cover?
recall.answer: Linear algebra from zero, probability from zero, calculus, statistics, optimization, information theory, capstone labs.

recall.question: What is the capstone?
recall.answer: Autograd from scratch, and Adam versus SGD on a toy landscape; build once, extend forever.

recall.question: Why does training pay bits?
recall.answer: Information theory: training a language model pays bits to remove surprise.
